title: FB-044 FB-045 refresh guardrail inventory globs

behavior_after: God-file policy covers src/mediapipeline plus promoted ops roots, and risky file registry uses a generated-summary file glob.
manual_validation: Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.python.tooling.test_godfile_guard tests.python.tooling.test_risky_file_registry -q passed, 17 tests.
test_godfile_guard and test_risky_file_registry passed; check_godfiles explicit promoted roots passed; check_risky_file_registry passed.
rollback_plan: Restore the prior registry glob entries and rerun the focused guardrail tests.
notes: Combined because both findings are isolated guardrail inventory glob maintenance.
